synth.notes:
Player moves 5 cells per A1-4; hidden walls (39,5),(34,10); portal (9,5)->(34,5).
step_bar costs 2 for every accepted action (w-=2, x=55-w, tag=str(w)), wall-blocked moves included; hud_glyph stays fixed (that is the 'no_change' counter in the hypothesis).
A refuel ring fully covered by the player is used up and refills the bar to 42. A covered target is hidden and comes back when uncovered (memory only kept while states stay continuous).
Step-134 counterexample: a move whose destination overlaps the chamber target (legend), or leaves the board, is refused with no cost, so the state is unchanged.
Not confirmed: what unlocks the chamber, and whether off-board moves cost a step (never observed).
